description: This file contains the implementation of the CodeGenerator class and related configuration for the Orleans code generation process. It includes methods for generating serialization code, proxies, metadata, and managing symbols and attributes within the Orleans project.

classes.name: CodeGeneratorOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the Orleans code generator, including attribute lists and generation settings.

classes.name: CodeGenerator
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating serialization, proxies, metadata, and handling symbol analysis within Orleans source code.

methods.name: GenerateCode
methods.description: Generates the complete code compilation unit based on the analyzed symbols and attributes.

methods.name: AddMember
methods.description: Adds generated syntax members to a specified namespace within the internal collection.

methods.name: VisitInterface
methods.description: Processes interface symbols to generate associated proxies and invokable descriptions.

methods.name: GetProxyBases
methods.description: Retrieves proxy base types associated with a given interface.

methods.name: GetProxyBase
methods.description: Gets the proxy base description for a specific interface type.

methods.name: TryGetProxyBaseDescription
methods.description: Attempts to get the proxy base description from attributes on an interface type.

methods.name: GetInvokableInterfaceDescription
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the description of an invokable interface and its proxy class.

methods.name: GetProxyMethodDescription
methods.description: Generates method descriptions for proxies, including serialization and invocation logic.
